sourceEvidence.text: Bread continues an Old English word that could denote a morsel or crumb as well as bread. It eventually displaced hlaf as the ordinary bread name, while hlaf survives as loaf. Scholars differ over the more distant origin, including whether the central idea was cooked food or a fragment of food; that dispute should remain explicit.
